_what: Files under skills/ that carry no seal on purpose, each with its reason. tools/check-skill-conformance.py reads this list (its check 7): every tracked file in a skill folder is sealed, or is named here; a listed file that is sealed, or that is gone, is a finding too, so the list cannot go stale. A file belongs here only when a seal would defeat it: a stand-in a test plants and reads, or a retired seal shape that must stay exactly as it is. Nothing outside skills/ is read from here.

files.skills/bonsai-garden-crew-page/fixtures/: a stand-in renderer the crew page's test (scripts/test_build_crew_data.py) runs in place of the real seal drawing; a seal on a stand-in would say it is the real thing
the stand-in verifier beside it: it answers from a .fakeseal sidecar with no keys, so the test never touches a real seal
files.skills/bonsai-garden-sign/fixtures/embed: a synthetic document carrying only a retired embedded v1 seal, the negative fixture of test-sidecar-negative.mjs; a v2 sidecar beside it would make it something else
the fixture signer's fingerprint, part of the planted root that fixture is verified against; the signer's key exists nowhere, so nothing could seal it
the same fixture signer's public key, for the same reason
